subject: Is there any effort to implement ML algorithms on the lines of MLLib, H2o or Mahaout using rmr?

messages.author: a7ec8b23e9012472
messages.subject: Is there any effort to implement ML algorithms on the lines of MLLib, H2o or Mahaout using rmr?
parts:
I found few examples in the tutorial e.g. kmeans, logistic regression etc. Is there any effort to implement these algorithms or statistics packages using rmr/plyrmr.

MLLib (exposed through SparkR) and H2o (which has an R package) are other viable alternatives. It would be great if RHadoop community has an effort in a similar direction.

Thanks,
Kr Deepak
